title: Other Ways to Say "Yes" in English #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Yes" in English. Don't say "Yes". Say this instead:
• Sure. (casual)
• Of course. (to a request)
• Absolutely. (strong)
• Definitely. (certain)
• You bet. (casual, American)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
